name: rivetos
description: RivetOS extensions for Cursor Grok Bot: persistent cross-agent memory (recall + gated write tools) backed by the shared RivetOS datahub.

plugins.name: rivethub-grokbot
plugins.description: RivetHub member kit for Grok Bot: shared memory MCP, onboard (cloud vs local DataHub), status, mesh-delegate skill. Same plugin either mode. Install then run rivetos-onboard. House nodes can keep ~/.rivetos/.env.

plugins.name: rivet-memory-grokbot
plugins.description: RivetOS memory for Grok Bot (MCP sibling launched by rivethub-grokbot). Recall + gated write tools. Plugin vars first, then ~/.rivetos/.env. Requires a built RivetOS checkout at /opt/rivetos (or RIVETOS_ROOT).
